confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Mexican colonial and expat tourist towns, not live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately certain. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because San Miguel's lodging market is seasonal and varies widely. Cocktail and wine are direct estimates for this window, not derived from beer. The FX observation was taken from a search result summary of the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page; I did not open the RBA page itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is general knowledge of mid-sized Mexican colonial tourist and expat towns such as Guanajuato, Oaxaca and Puebla, adjusted for San Miguel's higher tourist and expat demand. No city-specific web sourcing was used for the anchors.
